Pukwudgie are passive until threatened. These gentle cousins to the troll are less aggressive but much better defended. When faced with possible combat, the Pukwudgie raises the quills on its body and spins around, smashing an opponent with its quill-covered tail. If out of range, of opponent, it uses a javelin.

Size: Giant Armor Class 16
Hit Points (8d10+ 40)
Speed 30 ft. ft.
STR 18 (+4)
DEX 13 (+1)
CON 20 (+5)
INT 7 (-2)
WIS 9 (-1)
CHA 7 (-2)
Proficiency Bonus +3
Skills Perception +2
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12 Keen Smell: The Pukwudgie has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Ranged: Attack.The Pukwudgie makes one attacks: one with its Javelin.  Ranged weapon (Piercing)
range: 30/120
Melee Attack: Sticky Quill: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. When the Pukwudgie strikes with its back, it dislodges 1d6 quills that automatically break off and lodge in the opponent’s flesh. A lodged quill imposes a –1 circumstance penalty to attacks, saves, and checks. Each 1 round thereafter, the quill moves deeper into the opponent’s flesh, dealing 1d2 additional points of damage. Removing the quill takes 1 full round and deals 1d4 additional points of damage. If the quill has been embedded for more than 10 rounds, a Strength check at DC 10 is needed to remove the quill. For every minute after that, the DC to remove a lodged quill increases by +1. An unarmed or melee touch attack against a Pukwudgie causes 1d4 quills to break off and lodge in the attacker.

It starree so subtle Baeshra didn't  even notice her foot beginning to tap to the music in her mind. Just a gentle tap with the rhythm. That is until she began to sing...
"Just a swamp town lizard, living in a lonely world. She took the mightnight sub going anywhere"
Unsure where the song came from Baeshra looked around confused and reached for a nearby broom.
"Just a city spider, born and raised in London. They took the midnight sub, going anywhere."
Baeshra pulled the broom to herself, not defensively but like a dance partner, the way Web would hold her during thier dances. She swept across the kitchen with her "partner" in tow. Baeshra spun with them into the center of the pub.
"A long coat in a smoky room, the smell of wine and daffodil perfume." 
Baeshra is enraptured with the music. She let's the music lead. Giving herself to it as she lifts the broom in a spin.
"For a smile he would save the world. And we'll go on and on and on and on."
Baeshra lowers the broom. It's no longer her partner in this dance. She  sings into the broom as if it would make the whole town hear. 
"Strangers fighting, up and down the island. They're just trying to survive." 
Baeshra's head snaps up to the ceiling as she sings, she holds the broom out from her letting it dip as her other hand reaches to the tarp over the ceiling.
"Torchlight people, living to find emotion, hiding somewhere in the night."
Baeshra snaps back to the broom to sing into it. She starts tapping  her foot a harder as she sings , she starts point to the other patrons one at a time.
"Hunting hard to get my fill, everybody wants a thrill. Paying anything just to roll the dice just one more time."

Baeshra starts dancing across the room with the broom again dancing between tables and rubble. Lost in ger own world.
"All will win, hunger will lose, the gods will have to snoooze. But the tales will never end, we'll go on and on and on and on."
Baeshra returns to the center and sings at the broom. She raises a hand several times trying to get people to sing the chorus with her.
"Strangers fighting, up and down the island. They're just trying to survive. Torchlight people, just living to find emotion, hiding somewhere in the night."
Baeshra holds the broom differently and higher. She mimics  playing an oversized lute as her head sways side to side. Her eyes shut enjoying the moment.
"Don't stop believing, hold on to this feeling.  Torchlight people, dont stop believing. Hold on."
Baeshra begins signing into the broom again as she climbs up onto a chair, then a stool, then finally standing in the bar itself. 
"Torchlight people. Don't stop believing. Hold on to this feeling. Torchlight people. Don't stop!" 
Baeshra finishes her song breathing hard. She's not sure what came over her. She's barely sure how she got onto the counter. She quickly shyly climbs down from the counter  before running out of the bar embarrassed.
